name: serde_json
input_api: serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&[u8]); serde_json::Value::{Object, Array, String, Number, Bool, Null}; Number::as_f64(); Map::keys()
scope: One RFC 8259 JSON text decoded from memory into an untyped serde_json::Value tree: root kind, object, array, boolean and null counts, container nesting depth, sorted decoded strings (escape sequences resolved), sorted numbers as f64, sorted top-level object keys

name: simd-json

family: simd-json Rust SIMD/SWAR port of simdjson; own Deserializer stage1/stage2 and OwnedValue DOM, distinct from serde_json parser
